overview.description: The Grayscale Zcash Trust (ZCSH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long zec, short usd currency. One of the first securities solely invested in and deriving value from the price of ZEC. Grayscale Zcash Trust is solely and passively invested in ZEC. ZCSH was launched on Aug 25, 2026 and is issued by Grayscale.
